newsitem.title: UK: Reuters drops amid currency worries.
newsitem.headline: Reuters drops amid currency worries.

text.p: Shares in Reuters Holdings Plc dropped on Wednesday amid talk that the continued strength of sterling could prompt further cuts to earnings projections, dealers and analysts said.
The stock was down 22p at 569-1/2 by 0902 GMT in volume of just over three million shares.
Analysts at Salomon on Tuesday cut their pre-tax profit estimates for Reuters as part of a review of the media sector and dealers said other downgrades could be on the way.
For 1997, Salomon cut its pre-tax profit estimate to 700 million stg from 720 million and for 1998 it cut to 737 million stg from 815 million.
Analyst David Forster at Salomon said he remained positive on the stock longer-term but he advised investors to hold off until a round of earnings reductions works it way through the market.
